dz: 安德罗尼科斯四世·帕拉伊洛戈斯被武力攻入君士坦丁堡并俘虏了父亲约翰·瓦·帕拉伊洛戈斯皇帝,以及1373–1379年拜占庭内战期间的弟弟.
de: Andronikos IV Palaiologos enters Constantinople by force and captures his father, emperor John V Palaiologos, and his younger brothers during the Byzantine civil war of 1373–1379.
